summary: Phase 4 (recovery pathway + priority + workflow + decision table + evidence_label + no-percentage + hedged language) verified end-to-end. Created new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_pathway.py using 3 module-scoped live AI POSTs (credit-conservation mode). All 12 backend Phase-4 tests passed. Frontend UI verified: pathway-block, priority chip, workflow ol (11 items), decision-table (5 rows), evidence-label without '%'. No '(NN%)' pattern anywhere on results view or in PDF/DOCX/XLSX exports. Previous Phase 1-3 behavior (3 recommendations, image validation, history persistence, report downloads) preserved.

issues: Long underscored structure name 'TEST_p4_minor_localized' still wraps mid-word ('localize\nd') in H1 due to missing overflow-wrap/word-break — cosmetic issue also flagged in iteration 7.

action_items: (Cosmetic, low priority) Add `overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: break-word;` to .result-header h1 (still present from iteration 7).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~510 lines with heavy inline PDF/DOCX/XLSX generation (single-line report builder). Highly recommended to split into /app/backend/reports/{pdf,docx,xlsx}.py and a pathway/priority helper module for maintainability and testability.

PATHWAY_VALUES/PRIORITY_VALUES/WORKFLOW_STEPS/DECISION_TABLE are static module-level constants — good. But WORKFLOW_STEPS and DECISION_TABLE are duplicated inside every persisted record; consider storing only IDs and reconstructing on read to reduce DB payload size.

AssessmentCreate model does not validate component_type / integrity_status / damage_type / construction_material against enums — silently accepts arbitrary strings. Add Pydantic Literal or validators to catch client typos.

normalize_advice() writes evidence_confidence.percentage into the DB even though the UI no longer displays it. If percentages are truly deprecated from user-facing output, consider setting to None to avoid leaking a number through /api/assessments listing.

Frontend App.js is still a single dense file with each React component minified onto one JSX line. Splitting EvidencePanel, Results, and Form into dedicated files would greatly improve readability and DRY.
downloading a report performs GET on a public /api/assessments/{id}/report/{fmt} with no auth — acceptable for MVP but callout for future access control.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_p4_minor_localized, TEST_p4_insufficient, TEST_p4_demolish_q via live AI. History count grew to 50+.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-4 regression lives at /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_pathway.py — uses 3 module-scoped AI calls reused across 12 tests to stay credit-cheap. Env var TEST_BASE_URL required. Recovery pathway derivation covered: insufficient->Further Investigation, minor+clean->Localized Repair, demolish-question->never Replacement, hedged mechanism language enforced, and PDF/DOCX/XLSX absence of '(NN%)' patterns.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found this iteration.
